notes: three branches opened by «ح»; «كلهم عن حصين» is the convergence, so the tail is written once for all three
«- يعني ابن عبد الله -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
«فذكر بمعنى حديث عبيد الله بن أبي رافع عن علي» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route of this saying
the variant group's last link علي is the same Companion as the tail; the tail is not repeated for it
